title: 第一百三十章 活过来的镇北王第一百二十九章 本命神通与剑道
content_zh:
第一百三十章活过来的镇北王
“其实你我都知道，今日这一战，没有胜败，只有生死。”洛行舟轻轻擦掉嘴角的鲜血，眼中泛起些许萧凉看不透的光芒。
极为诡异的是，只是片刻之间，洛行舟的伤势竟然就恢复过来。
萧凉看着洛行舟，神色在不住变化，他总觉得眼前这一幕有些熟悉，像是在什么地方见过。
“生死之战，你也不是我的对手。”萧凉的目光不由投向不远处的昭华，她可不是娇滴滴的公主，而是拥有天命境巅峰修为的高手。
要是能够直接杀死昭华，萧凉感觉到自己便可借助纯粹剑修之道的特殊，直接进阶天命境。
只是眼下这般境况，想要杀死昭华，何其艰难。
一直帮助昭华的王家，到现在为止，王柏和王宣都还没有出手。
此外，王家在这场战斗之中，究竟布置了多少人马，也未可知。
到现在为止，说实话萧凉几乎一点希望都还没有看到。
这个时候，他不由抬头看向青山的方向，难道程观策等人，此时真的被那座所谓的囚天阵给困住了吗？
要知道叶流苏绝对是这天地之间最顶尖的阵法大师，连她也破不开囚天阵吗？
“萧凉，你们今天没有机会的。”洛行舟轻轻拍手，霎时间，有无数穿着盔甲的将士冲杀过来。
这些人的修为，竟然都在洞幽境，他们足足有上千之多。
当他们杀向两军交战的战场，刘望和他手下的禁卫军，此时便只能被屠杀，几乎没有还手的余地。
“看到了吗？萧凉，今日这个局，就是为你们布置的。”昭华的声音传出，如雷霆炸响。
“不管你们还有多少人，今日来这里，其实都只是我的选择而已，所以正如你所说，今日一战，没有胜败，只有生死。”
“好一个只有生死，既然你这般执着，朕没有不成全的道理。”
昭华怒笑一声，随后便让王家的高手，与洛行舟一同围向萧凉而来。
而此时，苏清绾也被围住。

整个战场，看上去萧凉一行人，根本没有任何胜算。
就在这时，一声剧烈的响动忽然传来，大地猛地摇晃了一下，所有人都被惊吓到，朝着外面看去。
忽然间，有人露出惊骇之色，“这盔甲······他们是镇北军，是镇北军······”
当此之际，昭华和屠方，以及洛行舟等人，都像是见鬼了似的，眼中充满了惊骇之色。
因为不只是镇北军在这里，为首的那人，竟然是已经被他们杀死的镇北王姬临风。
看到姬临风，萧凉嘴角不由掀起微微笑意，他知道今日这个局，不是他胜利了。
而是青山书院胜利了。
所以，那座笼罩青山书院的囚天阵，有叶流苏在，就是一座寻常阵法而已。
“姬临风，你怎么还没死？”屠方不敢接受这个事实，这也太诡异了一些，毕竟是他亲手将姬临风脑袋砍下来的。
“我没有死，不过今天你要死了。”姬临风手轻轻一挥，手下的镇北军顿然形成合围之势。

Chapter 130: The Living King of Zhenbei
"Actually, you and I both know that in today's battle, there is no victory or defeat, only life and death." Luo Xingzhou gently wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and there was a light in his eyes that Xiao Liang couldn't see through.
What is extremely strange is that Luo Xingzhou recovered from his injuries in just a moment.
Xiao Liang looked at Luo Xingzhou, his expression changing constantly. He always felt that the scene in front of him was familiar, as if he had seen it somewhere.
"In the battle of life and death, you are no match for me." Xiao Liang couldn't help but cast his eyes on Zhaohua, who was not far away. She was not a delicate princess, but a master with the peak cultivation level of Destiny Realm.
If he could kill Zhaohua directly, Xiao Liang felt that he could directly advance to the destiny realm with the help of the special way of pure sword cultivation.
But in the current situation, it is extremely difficult to kill Zhaohua.
The Wang family has been helping Zhaohua, but so far, Wang Bai and Wang Xuan have not taken action.
In addition, it is unknown how many troops the Wang family deployed in this battle.
Up to now, to be honest, Xiao Liang had almost no hope at all.
At this time, he couldn't help but look up in the direction of Qingshan. Could it be that Cheng Guance and others were really trapped by the so-called Heaven Prison Formation at this time?
You must know that Ye Liusu is definitely the top formation master in the world. Even she can't break the prison formation?
"Xiao Liang, you have no chance today." Luo Xingzhou clapped his hands gently, and in an instant, countless soldiers in armor rushed over.
The cultivation of these people is actually in the Cave Nether Realm, and there are thousands of them.
When they rushed towards the battlefield where the two armies were fighting, Liu Wang and his imperial guards could only be massacred, with almost no room to fight back.
"Did you see it? Xiao Liang, today's game is just for you." Zhaohua's voice sounded like thunder.
"No matter how many of you there are, coming here today is actually just my choice. So as you said, in today's battle, there is no victory or defeat, only life and death."
"A good person can only live or die. Since you are so persistent, there is no reason why I can't help you."
Zhaohua laughed angrily, and then asked the Wang family's masters to surround Xiao Liang together with Luo Xingzhou.
At this time, Su Qingwan was also surrounded.
On the entire battlefield, it seemed that Xiao Liang and his party had no chance of winning.
At this moment, a violent noise suddenly came, and the ground shook violently. Everyone was frightened and looked outside.
Suddenly, someone looked horrified, "This armor... They are the Zhenbei Army, they are the Zhenbei Army..."
At this moment, Zhaohua, Tu Fang, Luo Xingzhou and others all seemed to have seen a ghost, their eyes filled with horror.
Because not only was the Zhenbei Army here, but the leader was actually the Zhenbei King Ji Linfeng who had been killed by them.
Seeing Ji Linfeng, Xiao Liang couldn't help but smile. He knew that he was not the winner in today's game.
But Qingshan Academy won.
Therefore, the Heaven Prison Formation that covers Qingshan Academy, with Ye Liusu around, is just an ordinary formation.
"Ji Linfeng, why are you not dead yet?" Tu Fang did not dare to accept this fact. This was too weird. After all, he was the one who chopped off Ji Linfeng's head with his own hands.
"I'm not dead, but you are going to die today." Ji Linfeng waved his hand lightly, and his Zhenbei Army suddenly formed an encirclement.
